title: Date picker
summary: A custom calendar and time picker in one overlay, with date-only, time-only, and date-period variants.
overview: The default opens a single custom picker containing a calendar and a dedicated time control layout. Variants provide date-only, time-only, and single-calendar start/end date selection.

component.useWhen: Use the custom calendar when the browser-native date control does not match the application interface, or choose a variant for date-only, time-only, or date-period input.
component.avoidWhen: Avoid custom date UI when the native control is a better fit for the device, or when a full scheduling workflow needs time zones, availability, and recurrence rules.

days?.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]')?.focus();};const close=restore=>{panel.hidden=true;trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(restore)trigger.focus();};const toggle=()=>{const open=panel.hidden;panel.hidden=!open;trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));if(open)(days?.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]')||panel.querySelector('[data-time-up]')||panel.querySelector('[data-month-prev]'))?.focus();};const source.javascript: export function createDatePicker(root){const mode=root.dataset.mode,trigger=root.querySelector('[data-picker-trigger]'),panel=root.querySelector('[data-picker-panel]'),days=root.querySelector('[data-calendar-days]'),monthLabel=root.querySelector('[data-month-label]'),result=root.querySelector('[data-date-result]'),hint=root.querySelector('[data-picker-hint]');if(!trigger||!panel||!result)throw new Error('Date picker markup is incomplete.');const parse=value=>{const [y,m,d]=value.split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d,12);};const iso=date=>`${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;const format=date=>new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'}).format(date);let month=parse(root.dataset.value||root.dataset.start||'2026-06-12');let choosingEnd=false;const timeText=()=>`${String(Number(root.dataset.hour||9)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Number(root.dataset.minute||30)).padStart(2,'0')}`;const update=()=>{let text='';if(mode==='range'){const start=root.dataset.start,end=root.dataset.end;text=end?`${format(parse(start))} – ${format(parse(end))}`:start?`${format(parse(start))} – choose end date`:'';trigger.textContent=text||'Choose date period';hint.textContent=end?'Select a new start date to begin another period.':start?'Select an end date.':'Select a start date.';}else if(mode==='time-only'){text=timeText();trigger.textContent=text;}else{const date=format(parse(root.dataset.value));text=mode==='date-time'?`${date} · ${timeText()}`:date;trigger.textContent=text;}result.textContent=text;};const renderCalendar=()=>{if(!days)return;monthLabel.textContent=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{month:'long',year:'numeric'}).format(month);days.replaceChildren();const first=new Date(month.getFullYear(),month.getMonth(),1,12),start=new Date(first);start.setDate(1-first.getDay());for(let index=0;index<42;index++){const day=new Date(start);day.setDate(start.getDate()+index);const value=iso(day),button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className=`date-day${day.getMonth()!==month.getMonth()?' date-day--outside':''}`;button.textContent=String(day.getDate());button.setAttribute('aria-label',format(day));if(mode==='range'){const a=root.dataset.start,b=root.dataset.end;const inRange=a&&b&&value>=a&&value<=b;if(inRange)button.classList.add('is-range');if(value===a)button.classList.add('is-range-start');if(value===b)button.classList.add('is-range-end');button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(value===a||value===b));}else button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(value===root.dataset.value));button.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(value));days.append(button);}};const choose=value=>{if(mode==='range'){if(!root.dataset.start||root.dataset.end){root.dataset.start=value;root.dataset.end='';choosingEnd=true;}else{if(value<root.dataset.start){root.dataset.end=root.dataset.start;root.dataset.start=value;}else root.dataset.end=value;choosingEnd=false;renderCalendar();update();close(true);return;}renderCalendar();update();days.querySelector('.is-range-start')?.focus();return;}root.dataset.value=value;renderCalendar();update();if(mode==='date-only')close(true);else days?.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]')?.focus();};const close=restore=>{panel.hidden=true;trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(restore)trigger.focus();};const toggle=()=>{const open=panel.hidden;panel.hidden=!open;trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));if(open)(days?.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]')||panel.querySelector('[data-time-up]')||panel.querySelector('[data-month-prev]'))?.focus();};const prev=()=>{month.setMonth(month.getMonth()-1);renderCalendar();};const next=()=>{month.setMonth(month.getMonth()+1);renderCalendar();};const onKey=event=>{if(event.key==='Escape'&&!panel.hidden){event.preventDefault();close(true);}};const onOutside=event=>{if(!root.contains(event.target))close(false);};const timeButtons=[...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-time-up],[data-time-down]')];const onTime=event=>{const button=event.currentTarget,unit=button.closest('[data-time-unit]').dataset.timeUnit,key=unit==='hour'?'hour':'minute',step=unit==='hour'?1:5,max=unit==='hour'?24:60;let value=Number(root.dataset[key]||0);value=(value+(button.hasAttribute('data-time-up')?step:-step)+max)%max;root.dataset[key]=String(value);button.closest('[data-time-unit]').querySelector('[data-time-value]').textContent=String(value).padStart(2,'0');update();};trigger.addEventListener('click',toggle);panel.querySelector('[data-month-prev]')?.addEventListener('click',prev);panel.querySelector('[data-month-next]')?.addEventListener('click',next);panel.addEventListener('keydown',onKey);document.addEventListener('pointerdown',onOutside);timeButtons.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',onTime));renderCalendar();update();return{destroy(){trigger.removeEventListener('click',toggle);panel.removeEventListener('keydown',onKey);document.removeEventListener('pointerdown',onOutside);timeButtons.forEach(button=>button.removeEventListener('click',onTime));}}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-date-picker]').forEach(createDatePicker);

variants.summary: Choose a start date and end date in sequence from one calendar popup.
variants.useWhen: Choose a start date and end date in sequence from one calendar popup.
variants.avoidWhen: Avoid this variant if the task requires a different date or time value.
customization: The first selection starts a period and the next selection completes it in the same calendar.
Selecting an earlier end date automatically orders the period chronologically.
Adjust the range highlight styles and date formatting in CSS and the Intl format options.

example.title: Date period
example.description: Choose a start and end date from the same calendar. The first click marks the start; the next click completes and highlights the selected period.
